Now... hand over your entire coin bundle. Cough it up, I know you don't have many.
现在……将手里的铜钱全都交出来。虽然你手中的数量也没多到要说“全都”的程度。
dataList.place:
Evaluation Arena 1F - Lab Ruins
评审场1层 实验室废墟

dataList.content:
But... if you take all my coins, I'll be eliminated...
唔……如果这些全被拿走的话……我会被立刻淘汰的……

Yes, exactly. Are eliminated candidates subject to summary execution here?
没错，正好呢。这里的淘汰者会被立刻处决吗？

T-that wasn't a rule...
没……没有这种规则……

Looks like some candidates have finally had some exciting run-ins with one another!
现在，有几名候选人终于迎来了激烈的邂逅呢。

As a reminder, the goal of this game is to collect as many coins as possible within the given time limit.
这次大战的核心是，在规定时间内尽可能多地收集铜钱。

Sure, cooperation and alliances are all well and good, but when negotiations go up in smoke, might becomes a pretty reliable fallback plan.
虽然候选人间互相合作和拉拢也不错，但如果对话没法顺利进行的话，武力会成为一个不错的答案。

Don't you worry, though! The shadows of Hongyuan hiding in the corners of the arena will safely guide any coinless candidate out of the building.
尽管如此也请放心！被夺走所有铜钱的候选人，会由建筑物中潜伏的鸿园之影带领离场。

Oh, by the way—resisting them is kind of a terrible idea. I heard they're faster to act than to talk.
啊，我劝各位不要反抗他们。听说他们都是动手不动口的呢。

They must have placed the Heishou here.
他们部署了黑兽。

W-what the hell, that's bullshit!
我、我可没听过那种事！

Of course, if you've lost more than your coins... your life, for example... I suppose the Heishou'll be escorting your corpse out of here instead. Ha ha ha!
当然，如果不仅仅是铜钱，连性命也被人夺去的话……他们大概就要带领尸体离场了呢，哈哈哈！

... You heard her. Would you like to have your corpse escorted out, or would you rather leave on your own accord?
……这样啊。你是想作为尸体离场呢，还是想至少保住这条命呢？

Fine... my coins are yours. Take them all...
我……全部奉上……随便拿吧……

Aha, a candidate from the Shi family has been eliminated from the game. What an overwhelmingly dominating display of charisma from the opposing candidate's clan member!
现在，有一名史家的候选人被淘汰了。他被对方魄力十足的家族势头所压垮了呢。

If you've been eliminated, please come out to the hallways, forfeit your weapons, and wait for further instructions. Please note that any eliminated candidate loses all rights and privileges appertaining to candidates of Family Hierarch Evaluations, and...
淘汰者请来走廊，放下武器等待。被淘汰的候选人将被剥夺一切家主评审相关的机会和权限……

Ohh, I remember now. His name's Shi Huazhen~
啊，我想起来了。他名叫史华贞~

We're already up to seven coins, huh?
那我们已经收集到了七枚铜钱吗？

Hey, that's not bad! Let's wrap this up asap and get the heck outta this creephouse~
不错的收获嘛？让我们赶紧结束，然后离开这片阴气森森的地方吧~

We are beset in all directions by sorrow and tragedy. This appears to have been a laboratory for an unknown purpose...
四周笼罩着浓郁的阴影。这里貌似是为某种目的而设的实验室……

Yi Sang's eyes scan over the various machines that are messily strewn about the room.
李箱将视线投向散落的众多器具。

Kong family's laboratory, most likely.
大概是孔家的实验室。

Yeah... saw the plaque earlier. Apparently their entire family got completely annihilated after presumably breaking a Taboo or something.
啊……我看到牌匾了。传闻是说他们因为触犯禁忌而被灭门了吧？

Going by what Hong Lu said earlier... and gathering from everything we've heard about the Kong family so far... i-it sure sounds like they're all dead...
根据鸿璐先生的话……以及有关孔家的传闻来看，他们似乎真的全都死了呢……

It was in the time before the Jia family wielded as much power as it does now...
那是贾家像如今这般极盛前所发生的事情……

Boy, the Kong family really was something back then.
那时的孔家确实是名门望族。

Outputting a constant stream of new, groundbreaking Boluses with all kinds of unique qualities can't have been easy. But they somehow managed it back then.
持续生产出划时代性的全新丸药并不容易，但他们却做到了。

Because the Kong family had made such impressive contribution to the City as a whole, even past the boundaries of Hongyuan itself...
孔家不仅限于鸿园，对都市也作出了突出贡献……

... the other families had no choice but to watch in awe as it stood like a mountain so far above them.
其他家族只能望尘莫及。

Yes, I heard that they delved into various research subjects here.
没错，我听说他们进行过各种各样的研究。

Well. Despite all that glory, what awaited them at the end was a tragedy.
怎么说呢，不过是结局不太好罢了。

So there's no record or evidence of any kind left that could tell us what kind of experiments they carried out down here?
那连是什么实验的记录，都完全没有留下来吗？

Nope. It all got purged. Anything to do with their experiment has been practically atomized by the Claws that came here.
没错。这座都市里的所有关联资料都消失了。如果是包含有实验信息的物品，爪牙连一件也不会放过吧。

... Perhaps, in search of the novel, they failed to notice the avarice spiraling out of control; a recurring development among those whose passion is research.
……他们或许是在探求新事物时过于贪婪了。此对研究者而言，应该算是常事。

For a while, people from the high-and-mighty families of Hongyuan refused to even look in the general direction of this building. They thought it was heretical, that it would bring them misfortune.
有段时间鸿园的名门望族连这座建筑的方向都不会看上一眼，认为这是不敬。

Of course, I was pretty young then, so all this is just what the adults told me.
在那时我还年幼……所以这些都是从大人们那里听来的。

Do you recall aught from then... Hong Lu?
鸿璐……你还记得那时之事吗？

I was also very young, only ten years old, so my memories aren't very clear...
因为我那时只有十岁左右，所以记得不算清楚……

But I do. I recall.
但没错，我记得。

... I recall the day when the weight of avarice broke both the heavens above and the earth beneath the Kong family and smote them.
……欲望沉重到超越掌控，孔家天崩地裂的那一天。

But our existence is as fragile as paper, bound to fade away into nothingness just as they have.
说到底，我们也不过是终将如纸片般消散的存在。

So... I guess that's why we should always be mindful of excess, to empty ourselves that we will not overflow.
所以……任何事都不要过度，放空自己是很重要的吧。

Hong Lu spoke so calmly and clinically about the day when countless lives were lost.
鸿璐淡然谈论着，那无数生命瞬间消失的日子。

Thank... you so... much again... everyone... who is here today... for the Kong family and Hongyuan's... eternal... prosperity.
感谢……今日……为了孔家……与鸿园无限的繁荣……而到来的……各位。

This... must be a recording from before the Kong family's complete annihilation.
这些……应该是孔家遭遇灭门前的录音吧。

Hongyuan's Laboratory, Past
过去，鸿园的实验室
dataList.title:
Hongyuan's Laboratory
鸿园的实验室
dataList.content:
Do know that our success is a guarantee, so we would like to ask all research personnel to put their best into every project.
一定会成功的，所以恳请各位实验相关人员全力以赴。

Do you see now? It was not a matter of formula but rather the process, the order of formulation that diminished the efficacy of your previous Bolus.
明白了吗？之前的丸效果不佳，是因为调和顺序出了问题。

Let me demonstrate by example. Directly mixing two diametrically opposed ingredients—safflower (紅花), which carries an element of fire, with fleeceflower (何首烏), which carries an element of water—will cause a repelling reaction. What does the Kong family do in such a case?
比如说，火属性的红花与水属性的何首乌本来就处于两极，单纯地混合会产生排斥作用。这种时候，你们孔家会怎么做？

Mm. Use white peony (白芍藥) or gold in between the addition of either ingredient so that they may coexist.
嗯。在其中加入带有金气的黄金或白芍，可使材料的气性相生调和。

Yes, a rudimentary application of the Bolus production methodology. However, one thing we must know is that the law followed by our ingredients is not defined solely by the five phases and eight trigrams. Though the five phases are correctly aligned, ingredients each imbued with elements of the sexagenary cycle—distinguished by both the heavenly stems and the earthly branches—all exhibit different effects.
没错。这是基本的丸调和方法。但其实……我们所使用的材料，并不单单遵循五行八卦之法。即使顺理好了五行，具有六十甲子性质的材料，实际上也发挥着不同的功效……

Another aspect of this art to consider is that spacetime itself is a variable that modifies the laws by which yin and yang operate; thus, even if the same recipe were to be followed to the letter, the hour, the minute, and the second during which the Bolus is combined affects its quality and characteristics.
更何况阴阳之理会随时空而变化，所以哪怕是相同的调和方法，具体制作的时、分、秒，也会影响丸的特性以及质量。

So that's why following the same family recipes could yield Boluses of varying effects.
因此……尽管完全遵从了我们家族过去尝试的配方，也制作出了效果不同的丸药呢。

You must also remain wary of where one stores the Boluses once they are completed, and when to remove them from shade.
就连在何处保管调配好的丸，何时从阴处取出，都会让其产生变化。

Do keep in mind that a wise forger of Boluses always remains acutely aware of the harmony and discord that exists between ingredients.
丸药师必须经常察觉素材间的调和与排斥……多加小心为好。

You certainly have an exceptionally high degree of expertise when it comes to Boluses.
和往常一样，您在丸方面的专业性真是出类拔萃啊。

I cannot help but always depend on you so. You're the only person who would ever come up with such innovative ways to forge these boluses.
真可靠啊。能想到用这种方式尝试调和的，果然只有您了吧。

You've managed to untangle this side effect in a matter of moments, when we've struggled with it for months. We cannot help but feel a tinge of shame before your skill.
我们找了几个月也没有发现克服副作用的方法，现在却被这么简单地解决了，反倒叫我们颜面不保了。

... Consider this boon good karma for your vast and profound generosity.
……多亏了你们的心胸宽广，才能得到这样的回报。

It is all thanks to your wisdom and acumen, venerable Jia Mu.
这都多亏了老太太出色的能力与手段。

You deserve every reverence and admiration for coming this far, armed with nothing but your skill and wit.
您仅凭实力与慧眼而达到了此等地位，我认为应该被众人永远敬仰。

And as they admire your achievements, they'll find hope as well.
只有这样，在老太太的带领下，大家才能抱着希望活下去吧？

... Of course.
……正是如此。

No one could have possibly foreseen that the declining Shi family would produce the next Hierarch, after all. Especially someone without a proper clan.
谁会想到一个出身于地位衰落的史家、没有像样势力的人，能得到家主的宝座呢。

Oh...! That is not what I had intended to convey, venerable Jia Mu. If I had offended you, by any chance—
啊……！我并非那个意思。若我的发言让您感到不快的话……

Worry not, for you have spoken true.
没关系，你一个字也没说错。

I understand that it was all thanks to the Kong family's generosity that I could rise. I know better than anyone that you could have easily eliminated me before I had the chance to ascend to the seat of the Family Hierarch.
我比谁都清楚，这都是多亏了孔家的器量深厚。你们要是有那个意愿，我早就在继任家主宝座前被轻易排除掉了。

And you would have done so, had you wished to further solidify the Kong family's position here.
如果你们想让孔家的地位更为稳固，早就有充足理由那么做。

In fact, our hearts were truly stirred by the most unexpected outcome of the Family Hierarch war.
倒不如说，我们对家主之争的意外结局感到钦佩。

You have clutched victory with nothing but wisdom when all odds were against you.
因为您在那个称不上公平的环境中制定了明智的战略，夺得了第一。

Not to mention that we are greatly appreciative of all the assistance you have so graciously provided us.
而且，十分感谢您这次也在物质和精神上帮助了我们。

Save your compliments, please. I am only honored that you saw any use for my insignificant tricks.
别那么说，我才应该为能发挥我这并不出色的才能，而感到荣幸的。

After all, our collective pursuit is to prolong the eternal prosperity of Hongyuan, is it not?
而且我们都希望鸿园能无穷无尽地繁荣下去，对吧？

... Grandma, are you making new Boluses again?
……奶奶，您又在做新丸了吗？

Indeed, little Baoyu.
没错，宝玉啊。

There is karma to be repaid.
不能不偿还所受的业报啊。

And do I have to... keep coming here with you, grandma?
我也……必须一直和您一起去吗？奶奶？

Yes. This beautiful scenery will not be complete without you as its witness.
是啊，因为……这是只有你一直观望下去才能完成的绝景啊。

You have frequented this place… with regularity, Hong Lu?
鸿璐，你曾经常……来往这里吗？
dataList.place:
Evaluation Arena 1F - Lab Ruins
评审场1层 实验室废墟

dataList.content:
... Yes. Grandmother often brought me here to play, hand-in-hand.
……是的。奶奶经常拉着我的手来这里玩。

Oh, are you guys done collectively spacing out? I've been thinking while you were gone.
啊，在你们发呆的时候，我也在不断思考。

And I've come up with something quite interesting.
结果有了十分有趣的想象啊。

So, since the results of the second round are decided only when the time's up...
规定时间结束时，决定名次的物品，是这第二轮家主选拔的核心……

... I'm sure there are candidates out there coming up with strategies like...
那肯定会有候选人这样想。

"Collect a moderate amount of coins, find a nice, hidden corner to lie low, wait until everything blows over, and we just might walk away with a decent rank." Know what I mean?
只要收集适量的铜钱，静静潜伏在同一个地方的话……就能赢得相当高的名次……吧。

There are many points of failure to that plan, but... it would indeed be an appropriate strategy for candidates who are not so confident about their odds in open combat.
不稳定因素太多了……不过对于对战斗没有自信的候选人来说，是个有效的策略。

Right?
是吗？

But here's the thing. Wouldn't it make for such a boring show if most of the candidates are just hiding and doing nothing for the majority of the game? I mean, they even made the show of gathering an audience for this song and dance.
但是，明明连观众都特意找来现场直播了，如果都是那种候选人的话，观众们肯定会很无聊的吧？

There must be—
恐怕一定是……

I sensed a very subtle vibration the moment we walked out of the lab and into the hallways.
从实验室出来，走入另一条走廊的瞬间，我感到了些许微弱的震动。
dataList.place:
Evaluation Arena 1F
评审场内部 1层

dataList.content:
Wang Zhao must've felt it, too. He stopped in his tracks and looked around.
名为王照之人也感受到了，沉默地凝视着某个地方。

Hold on. Do you guys hear that?
喂。你们听到什么了吗？

Well... looks like this is where our brief fellowship comes to an end.
好吧……看来同行就到此为止。

That was a short but sweet exchange, Jia Baoyu.
虽然时间很短，但是谈话很令人愉悦，贾宝玉。

But... I don't think you're the one who should hold the most coins.
但是……我并不认为你会是这里拿到最多铜钱的人。

<What...?>
<这怎么说……>

Once the games end, I hope we'll all find what we came here for.
选拔结束之时，希望我们都能得到各自想要的东西。

We weren't planning on sticking with him through the entire round, but...
说到底他不过是半路同行的人……

Yeah, it's a bit sudden, huh? I guess it's better than a full-on betrayal.
虽然有些突然……但总比他在背后捅我们刀子要好。

W-we're going our separate ways, just like that...? 
就、就这样分开真的没问题吗？

... There is no time to spare worrying about him.
……没有时间担心那个人了。

Atten-tion! Full-speed sprint toward the 3'O clock direction! Go, go, go!
所有人！朝着三点钟方向全力奔跑！

Huh? W-what?! Oi, at least tell us what's going on!
欸？怎、怎么了！至少先告诉我们理由再跑吧！

Eyes forward! The walls are... rising from the floor!
向前看！地面上……正在升起墙壁！

That's when the host's cheerful voice began booming from the speakers, excitedly explaining the situation.
事到如今，仿佛是在解说现在的情况一般，主持人热情的声音传到了我们耳边。

Let's keep things interesting with... a new rule!
现在，这个时候~要颁布一条新规则！

And this one's for you, dear viewers who must've been bored outta your minds with how safe the candidates were playing things! Starting now, walls are gonna start closing off rooms and corralling our candidates every set interval, shrinking the arena!
为了不让观众因为候选人们谨慎的行动而感到无聊……从现在开始，每隔一段时间，候选人们可以停留的空间就会缩小！

If you somehow end up trapped in a room, if you fail to make it into the shrinking arena...? Well, that's an elimination, of course!
如果你们没能进入缩小后的空间，而是被外面的墙壁挡住的话……？当然就会被取消资格啦！

Of course...
果然……

Aha~ Looks like it's real chaotic out there! Now, let's try not to push your luck and get yourselves stuck between walls, mmkay? It'll be one hell of a clean-up job to have to scrape and scrub your bits off the walls. Better get moving!
啊~候选人们现在都陷入了极度混乱呢！要是强行行动而被墙壁夹住的话，清理起来会很麻烦的，所以快点行动比较好哦！

We began sprinting full-speed to where the walls were starting to rise from the floor, the host's snidely chipper tone taunting us the whole time.
听到主持人那拼命嘲讽的言语，我们全力向着逐渐升起墙壁的地方奔去。

Oof! Looks like some of you didn't make it! You were so close, too... And... ouch, I spy a candidate who's been separated from her clan in the chaos. Whoa, try not to lose your coins in the chaos!
哎呀，也有千钧一发之际跌倒没能跨过墙壁的候选人呢。哎呀哎呀……还能看到因为下属四处逃窜结果孤身一人的候选人呢。哦？小心别让铜钱掉落，要好好收好哦！
